dialogue_texts: My, what an oddly heavy atmosphere for a nighttime stroll.
This crimson haze feels quite stifling, wouldn't you say?
My Majesty, it is an honor to assist you.
The local courier has left the mail entirely abandoned because of this strange phenomenon.
I am Hiroyuki Shirogane, head of the Shirogane Manor - please allow me to guide you.
Fufufu, thank you, Shirogane-sama. You are quite chivalrous.
But look closely... it seems our little night bird is caught in a rather tragic state of mind.
If I shut away my heart... the weight of everyone's expectations can't crush me anymore...
Oh dear. Hiding away from the world to avoid the burden of your duties?
I suppose I know a thing or two about isolation, but yours looks entirely unnatural.
The Order granted me absolute peace...
A quiet dark where no letters go missing... and no mistakes exist...
Please step back, My Majesty! The glohm twists a person's inner anxieties into resentment.
Her danmaku will be remarkably hostile and unyielding under this curse!
An undying peace built on stagnation?
How sorrowful. A life without flaws or connections is no life at all.
Let my eternal light shine through your darkness and break this spell!
Your light means nothing here... Drown in the silent night!
